text: nno it is not. there is terrain maybe ~15-20 tiles away that is a spike but not on this staircase and that doesnt change the fact that a staircase anywhere else also does the same thing
resolution: Correction to req_1453: the staircase is a real stairs build piece (not the painted terrain spike ~15-20 tiles away I first mis-identified), and the block repros on ANY grid-aligned staircase. That re-aim is what led to the actual root cause and fix — see req_1453. Net: the staircase collision bug is fixed by raising HMSC_SCALE.playerStepHeightMeters 0.35->0.5 so the radius-induced crest lip on every walkable 45-53 degree stair/ramp clears at any framerate, with a Zig regression test pinning it (commit ab003a9ca).
